page.layout: One printed page of text, framed by a woodcut ornament border; a manuscript note in the left margin (handwriting, not printed, so not transcribed as text). Running head at top; page number at top left; text in one column; catchword "quæ" at lower right.

main_text.p: horum trium & omnium functio-nū in homine motrix atq; directrix causa, veluti Regina.

6. Caterum ut è quatuor elementis conglobato pulvere terræ vis corporum nostrorum atque vita integra est, si spiritus Mercurialis, tanquam humidum radicale, & anima sulphurea, tanquam calidum naturale, una cum salis consistentia à putredine asservantis, suaviter in unum conspirent: ita vice versa animam immortalem à corpore conglobati pulveris terræ separari necesse est, si vel in uno principiorum trium pluribusve defectus oboriatur: in toto quidem unde mors: in parte vero unde morbus: quod in septem Principalium membrorum anatomia præcipuè videre est.

page.notes: Manuscript annotation in the left margin (pencil/ink handwriting, partly illegible) was not transcribed. The printed line "7. Huic triplici defectui nihil a-" continues with "què" at the foot of the column, which is given as the catchword. Some words in the text are italic and have been rendered in roman or underlined where the scan is ambiguous.
